title: Missing in Nepal-Tibet Floods Reaches Over 4,700. Here’s What Else to Know.
summary: The authorities in Nepal and Tibet said that more than 4,400 people were missing since a deadly Himalayan landslide and glacial collapse. Rescuers are searching for survivors.
